title: GTA 6 original creators haven't played it yet
description: GTA 6 original creators Dave Jones and Brian Baglow haven't played the game yet, according to Livemint's report of a BBC interview with the pair.

body.text: The GTA 6 original creators are in the same position as every other fan: waiting to see the game. According to Livemint, which cited a BBC interview, GTA co-creator Dave Jones and original writer and publicist Brian Baglow have not played the upcoming title. It shows how tightly Rockstar Games is guarding a launch that has been nearly 13 years in the making.
GTA 6 original creators are still waiting

Livemint says the wait has included multiple delays and several major leaks, and that Rockstar has kept details closely guarded throughout. That secrecy reportedly reaches the people who built the first game.

"We're all waiting to see what they've done," Jones told the BBC, sitting next to Baglow. When asked whether either of them had played GTA 6, Baglow shook his head. According to the report, he seemed unbothered about not getting early access.
How the first GTA came together

The original Grand Theft Auto arrived in 1997 from DMA Design, a small studio in Dundee. Livemint notes it was tiny compared with the teams behind today's biggest releases. The studio had already scored a hit with the puzzle game Lemmings.
The next idea was a racing game, first called Race'n'Chase. Jones said the team always wanted to do something different and kept asking what unique spin they could add.

items: Players could leave their vehicles and explore on foot.
Driving, switching and stealing cars, and moving around outside them, combined different kinds of gameplay.
The team considered letting players be police officers too, but dropped the idea because it meant following established rules and procedures.

body.text: "At some point we just said, you know what, it's way more fun playing the bad guy," Jones said.
A slow burn that built on word of mouth

The first game did not take off straight away. According to Livemint, its commercial performance was initially slower than that of Lemmings. Jones called it a "slow burn" and said players had to experience the game themselves to see what made it different.

Baglow recalled that sales kept growing through the year after release, which the team put down to recommendations from players. "The people who had played it going, oh my God, have you played this game?" he said.

The source does not give a release date or any new details on GTA 6 itself, so nothing here confirms what the game contains. What it does show is that Rockstar's secrecy runs deep. Watch for official word from Rockstar as launch nears, and for whether people from the franchise's early days get a look before everyone else.

faqs.q: Have the original GTA creators played GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. According to Livemint, citing a BBC interview, GTA co-creator Dave Jones and original writer and publicist Brian Baglow have not had an early look at GTA 6. Baglow shook his head when asked if either had played it.

faqs.q: Who made the first Grand Theft Auto game?
faqs.a: Livemint reports that the first GTA launched in 1997 and was made by Dundee-based DMA Design. The studio had earlier found success with the puzzle game Lemmings.

faqs.q: Why did GTA let players be the criminal?
faqs.a: Jones said the team considered letting players be police officers too, but dropped it because that meant following established rules and procedures. In his words, it was far more fun playing the bad guy.
